execution_audit.checks: Every buy in known membership; every fill on positive-volume observed bar, modeled slippage bounded; next-bar timing, 100-share lots, 5-session sale guard, financial publication timing; no synthetic delisting sales

minute_audit.source: Vietcap real ONE_MINUTE, observed positive-volume common continuous sessions only

limitations: Current and provider-retained delisted catalog is not a complete historical security master; completely removed securities can still be missing. Reduces, does not eliminate, survivorship/data-availability bias.
Monthly selection uses actual observed trading history, not legal listing/suspension certificates. Missing or zero-volume/malformed candles never generate execution.
No historical market-cap or industry labels inferred; current ICB only for descriptive attribution. Corporate-action/total-return limitations remain.

Source OHLCV may be back-adjusted for later corporate actions, not original historical vintages; liquidity ranking and absolute price filters can retain adjustment/availability bias. Both cohorts use the same current source and protocol; this is not a fully reconstructed point-in-time security master or total-return dataset.
497 selected tickers have in-window minute bars; SJF has no in-window positive-volume daily/minute observations and remains selected in its ex-ante month. This is not replaced with another survivor.

The 146 control is rerun on the same current daily/minute source, volume guards, membership-exit and stale-valuation conventions, so differences are not attributed solely to the sample by comparing unlike engines. Original 146 snapshots remain separately available.

No candle/trade/exit is invented when quotes disappear. After20 market sessions without quotes, the conservative NAV reserves100% of stale exposure; last-observed-price NAV is also disclosed. A reserve is not an observed zero price, actual sale or assertion of total economic loss.

Annual fundamentals are current provider versions withheld until actual publication/update+1day, not original vintages. Missing or non-comparable statements exclude only the two value-model screens; no financial values are fabricated.
All new backtests and EOD paper replay share strict_next_candle_v1. Legacy forward paper is archived separately; replay starts 2026-11-13 and cannot report an unfinished session.
